parts.watchFor: Iblis goes wrong, and so do Adam and Hawwa. Watch what each one does next.

questions.q: What did God create the jinn from?
Why did Iblis refuse to bow to Adam?
options: He did not hear the command
He thought he was better than Adam
He was away from the heavens

questions.q: What did Adam and Hawwa do after they ate from the tree?
options: Turned back to their Lord and asked forgiveness

lesson.text: Everyone slips. Pride makes excuses, as Iblis did; repentance turns back, as Adam and Hawwa did. God accepts those who turn back.
lesson.curious: Muslims learn from this that every person makes mistakes, and that what matters is turning back to God rather than blaming others.

carry.title: Adam and Hawwa's prayer for forgiveness

reflect.muslim: Think of a time you were wrong. Did you make excuses, or did you turn back?
reflect.curious: Why do you think the story shows two different responses to a mistake?

parts.act: When you're wrong, admit it before you explain.
